title: List initial loading → rows, empty, unauthorized, error. Demo passes isLoading=false and fixture arrays.

blocked: Initial fixtures and live account lists do not fill a page. Requires enough isolated records to activate pagination; no shared backend seeding performed.

title: Refetch while list has visible rows → updated/removed rows and footer count, including selected row disappearing.
blocked: Requires concurrent backend writes/removals while subscribed; shared account is inspected read-only.

title: Move prompt asynchronous visibility consequences → confirmation → cancel; `src/console/folders/move/{prompt,confirm}.tsx`.
blocked: Requires isolated resources with conflicting inherited grants and backend-derived visibility impact; shared account moves are not submitted.

title: Table/store archive → archived menu → Restore pending → restored row; archived permanent delete → pending → removed.
blocked: Archived fixture state does not retain restore/permanent-delete actions; requires isolated backend archived material and mutation permission.

title: Create/edit/visibility/move/delete pending spinner inserted beside label → success/error/rest; failure toast appears → dismisses.
blocked: Fixture operations resolve synchronously; sustained save/error transitions require an isolated backend or deterministic response fixture.

title: Grid initial load → rows; load-more band → new virtual rows → New row affordance; deleting inspected column concurrently closes sheet.
blocked: Initial and load-more grid queries need enough backend rows beyond loaded fixture page; concurrent column removal requires isolated writes.

blocked: Version conflicts and write failures require isolated conflicting or faulted backend writes.
